title: Fallen Star speaker busts (shared portrait sets)
note: This cast came from the shared portrait library (high-resolution illustrations shown through src/player/bustPixelate.ts), not from char-gen + bake_astra_busts64. New members are made the same way (pipeline below) and imported; the blind review sees the on-screen pixelation (reviewView). Rules are derived from `calibrate` (cast range). Valen's old stand-in bust (shared blue-headband, jester-like) was rejected by the user on 2026-10-25 and is no longer in the lineup.

Same path as the 76 shared portraits; only the identity comes from text + chip because the role has no face set.
